# Third-party browser libraries

Unmodified local distributions; no CDN requests are needed at runtime.

- Marked 18.1.1: https://github.com/markedjs/marked (MIT).
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked@18.1.1/lib/marked.umd.js
- DOMPurify 3.4.17: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0).
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/dompurify@3.4.17/dist/purify.min.js

License texts are included alongside the distributions.
